nodes.description: Public pure function G_Face(uint32 traitId_) that returns a string[2] memory array; a pure lookup table selecting a base64-encoded face image based on the traitId_ argument.
Input parameter traitId_ of type uint32 used as the selector in a chain of equality comparisons against constant literals 0..15.
Local string variable _header holding a constant base64 prefix that is concatenated with per-trait suffixes via abi.encodePacked.

edges.reason: The parameter traitId_ flows into the function body and controls which of the constant comparison branches is taken and thus which return value is produced.
The local variable _header is passed into abi.encodePacked and its value is returned through the function's return statement.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter traitId_ is a non-core node whose only role is to be consumed by the pure lookup function G_Face; it can be normalized into that function node.
The local variable _header is a constant temporary used solely inside G_Face to build the return value; it can be normalized into that function node.
